title: Styles, Daniels & Joe: the X Division triangle
summary: Christopher Daniels’ title reign meets AJ Styles’ pursuit and Samoa Joe’s unbeaten rise. Their three-way rivalry pushes the X Division into the main event before Joe’s increasingly violent approach changes its tone.

chapters.title: Unbreakable’s three-way main event
chapters.result: Styles defeats Daniels and Joe to win the X Division championship.
chapters.context: Styles pins Daniels, so Joe leaves without the title but remains unpinned and unsubmitted. The finish keeps all three rivals’ claims alive.

chapters.title: Joe turns on his own partner
chapters.result: Joe attacks Christopher Daniels after their team’s match.
chapters.context: The assault shifts the rivalry from athletic competition toward revenge, giving Styles a personal reason to confront the unbeaten challenger.

chapters.title: Joe takes the X Division title
chapters.result: Samoa Joe defeats Styles to become X Division champion.
chapters.context: Styles tries to answer Joe’s aggression, but Joe’s power and submission offense carry him to the championship.
